Title: We’re ending support for the 2017-03-01-GA API.

Body.Content:
On September 2026, we’ll be ending support for the 2017-03-01-GA API. After that date, this preview API will no longer work.

Required action

To avoid errors due to using a deprecated API, please move to a newer version of the ACR API. You can find a list of supported versions here.

You may be consuming this API via one or more SDKs. Use a newer API version by updating to a newer version of the SDK. You can find a list of SDKs and their latest versions here.

Help and support

If you have questions, get answers from community experts in Microsoft Q&A. If you have a support plan and you need technical help, please create a support request.
